input.rationale: Based on the comparison you presented, the evidence supports the proposed cause in this local reproduction. The prepared statement worked across transactions on the same direct backend. Through PgBouncer, execution failed with 26000 after the measured switch to a different backend. The direct reset control produced the same error, which shows why the error code alone would not establish the cause. This acceptance is limited to the tested local workflow and does not establish a customer’s cause or select a remedy.

I want to validate the approach that allows the prepared statement to work across transactions when the pool assigns a different backend. The driver’s named prepared statements and the pooler’s prepared-statement support address that workflow. My selection applies only to the tested local workflow. Performance, statement eviction and managed-platform compatibility remain untested.
